# DevDigest frontend

Component and accessibility conventions for the web app. The lint hook needs ESLint installed in the project.

## What it adds

- Skills: `react-component`, `a11y-audit`
- Agents: `ui-reviewer`

## Install

```text
/plugin install devdigest-frontend@dev-digest-ai-marketplace
```

## What it runs

### lint-on-save

Runs the project's own ESLint config with --fix on the files Claude changed.
